verdict.rationale: The CLI lets you set a context length and GPU offload ratio for each model you load (`lms load --gpu=... --context-length=...`). The `--identifier` flag lets you name loaded instances, which implies you can run several and size each one's context separately. The evidence never documents running multiple instances concurrently or any shared memory-allocation controls across them, and nothing hands-on corroborates it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent multi-instance loading, KV-cache or memory budgeting across instances, parallel-slot or context-sharing controls, independent corroboration.
